rationale.scope: Budgets were fixed from documented guarantees and peer ceilings before any Sql capacity measurement; they are never tuned to an observed result. docs/sql/README.md publishes no latency or overhead guarantee ('performance/endurance and release qualification' remain).
rationale.workload: The runtime hot path is SqlQuery<TArguments,TResult>.ReadAsync: statement admission, the bounded outer LIMIT wrapper, result-shape validation, per-field byte admission and the typed projector, over a caller-owned BlueTusk.Data connection. The harness uses the public constructor with the same bind/read delegates the source generator emits (BlueTuskParameter<T> binding, GetFieldValue<T> reads), over eight tenants of 20,000 live orders while fixed-cardinality DML keeps rows changing. Every returned row is checked for tenant, ordering and an in-row checksum.
rationale.durationAndRepeats: Two clean exact-candidate runs of 30 minutes each, the minimum every other expansion capacity gate requires.
rationale.offeredRates: 500 point lookups/s, 100 100-row pages/s and 10 tenant aggregates/s. A read path must sustain at least the Documents family's minimumTransitionsPerSecond of 500 on its primary operation.
rationale.minimumAcceptedPerSecond: 95% of each fixed offered rate (Edge maximumSkippedFraction 0.05).
rationale.maximumRejectedFractionAndErrors: Zero. Sql has no admission control; SqlResultLimitException and SqlContractMismatchException are fail-closed guards that must never fire on the declared contracts.
rationale.point-lookup.maximumP99Milliseconds: 500 ms: a bounded indexed read must not be slower than the cheapest peer durable write ceiling (Documents maximumSaveP99Milliseconds 500).
rationale.range-page.maximumP99Milliseconds: 500 ms: the same bounded-read rule; the page is limited to 100 rows by both the query and maximumRows.
rationale.aggregate.maximumP99Milliseconds: 1000 ms: Studio executes the same admitted, LIMIT-wrapped read under QueryTimeoutSeconds (default 10 s); a tenth of that deadline, equal to the Projections business-commit ceiling.
rationale.application-write.maximumP99Milliseconds: 500 ms: single-row durable update, the Documents save ceiling; a breach means reads were measured on an unhealthy fixture.
rationale.verifiedRows.minimumPerSecond: 9975 rows/s = 475 point rows + 95 pages x 100 rows: the minimum accepted rates must return their full declared rows, not empty results.
rationale.maximumOwnedRelationBytes: 1 GiB: Search's owned-relation ceiling for a fixed-cardinality corpus.
rationale.maximumLateOwnedGrowthBytesPerMinute: 16 MiB/min: Documents' fixed-cardinality late-growth ceiling; reads write nothing and DML updates a fixed row set.
rationale.maximumDatabaseBytes: 8 GiB: the Search and Documents whole-database ceiling.
